title: The Letter on the Stairs
text:
Maria found an old letter on the stairs of her grandmother's house. The envelope was yellowed, and the handwriting was difficult to read. She decided to take it home and read it carefully before she told anyone about it.

The letter was written by a young man who had left the village in 1952. In it, he promised to return for a woman named Elena, but he never did. Maria felt sad when she understood the story, yet she also felt that the letter had a meaningful message for her family.

questions.text: Where did Maria find the letter?
options: On the stairs of her grandmother's house
In a library in the village
In a box at the post office

questions.text: In which year had the young man left the village?
Why did Maria decide to read the letter carefully before telling anyone?
options: She wanted to be sure of what it said before sharing it
She could not read at all
She wanted to sell the letter
She had already read it many times

questions.text: What can be inferred about the young man?
options: He intended to come back but did not
He lived in the village his whole life
He was a sailor who lived by the sea

vocabulary.definition: having turned a pale yellow color because of age
writing that is done by hand, not printed
said that you will certainly do something
having an important or useful purpose or message

paragraph_translations: Maria büyükannesinin evinin merdivenlerinde eski bir mektup buldu. Zarfın rengi sararmıştı ve el yazısını okumak zordu. Kimseye bundan bahsetmeden önce onu eve götürüp dikkatlice okumaya karar verdi.

Mektup, 1952'de köyden ayrılmış genç bir adam tarafından yazılmıştı. Mektupta Elena adında bir kadına geri döneceğine söz veriyordu, ancak asla dönmedi. Maria hikayeyi anladığında üzüldü, ama mektubun ailesi için anlamlı bir mesaj taşıdığını da hissetti.
